caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden frame with rounded golden accents at the corners and at intervals along each side, occupying the center of a plain beige background. Inside the upper part of the frame is a small, colorful building complex, which includes a pink tower with a red dome and cross, a yellow rectangular building, and a blue section, set amid green bushes and trees on a grassy hill under a light blue sky with soft white clouds. The lower part of the frame contains a gray-toned, slightly reflective surface that resembles a mirror, with visible scratches, cracks, and brownish marks, giving it a worn appearance. The artist’s name, "OSCAR BLUHM," is written in small letters in the bottom right corner outside the frame on the beige background.
title: Painted mirror
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
